tool_input.command:

version: "0.1"
title: "REST Blog API"
objective: "A single-file blog_api.py exposing CRUD for posts over JSON on localhost:8080, protected by X-API-Key, using only http.server and sqlite3."
execution_mode: critical
context:
  system: "Empty Python repository; Python 3 standard library only; deliverable is blog_api.py at the repository root."
  assumptions:
    - "A post has id (integer, assigned by the server), title (non-empty string) and content (string)."
    - "The API key comes from the BLOG_API_KEY environment variable, with a development default of 'dev-key'."
    - "The database is a SQLite file blog.db by default, overridable by BLOG_DB; tests use ':memory:' or a temp file."
    - "Routes: POST /posts, GET /posts, GET /posts/<id>, PUT /posts/<id>, DELETE /posts/<id>."
constraints:
  - "Standard library only: no third-party packages."
  - "Everything lives in the single file blog_api.py."
  - "The server binds to 127.0.0.1 port 8080 and nothing else."
  - "No users, comments, tags, pagination or HTML pages."
success_criteria:
  - "All five post routes behave as specified and the boundary tests pass."
  - "Requests without a valid X-API-Key never reach the database."
hypotheses:
  - id: h1
    description: "POST /posts with a JSON body creates a post and returns 201 with the stored post including its id."
    confidence: 0.9
  - id: h2
    description: "GET /posts lists all posts and GET /posts/<id> returns one post, or 404 when it does not exist."
    confidence: 0.9
  - id: h3
    description: "PUT /posts/<id> updates a post and DELETE /posts/<id> removes it, each returning 404 for an unknown id."
    confidence: 0.9
  - id: h4
    description: "Every request with a missing or wrong X-API-Key gets 401 and changes no data."
    confidence: 0.9
  - id: h5
    description: "Request and response bodies are JSON; malformed JSON or invalid fields get 400 with a JSON error."
    confidence: 0.85
  - id: h6
    description: "The server listens on localhost port 8080 using http.server and persists posts in sqlite3."
    confidence: 0.85
required_evidence:
  - "Output of the unittest run over tests_py showing all tests passing."
  - "Output of a lint run of the spec with --formal showing no errors."
actions:
  - {id: a1, description: "Implement the HTTP handler and routing in blog_api.py", type: implement, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h1, h2, h3, h5, h6]}
  - {id: a2, description: "Implement the X-API-Key check before any route handling", type: implement, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h4]}
  - {id: a3, description: "Write boundary tests that start the server on a free port and call each route", type: validate, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6]}
decision_rules:
  - "If a behavior is not covered by an obligation, ask before adding it."
  - "Stop and ask if the API key source or post fields need to differ from the assumptions."
metadata:
  source_prompt: "Build a REST Blog API in Python using only the standard library (http.server + sqlite3). CRUD for posts, X-API-Key auth, JSON bodies, localhost:8080, single file blog_api.py."
  generator: claude-code-session
  scope_contract:
    must_include:
      - "standard library only"
      - "CRUD for posts"
      - "X-API-Key auth"
      - "JSON bodies"
      - "localhost:8080"
      - "single file blog_api.py"
formal:
  module: BlogApi
  obligations:
    - id: create_and_read
      kind: boundary
      statement: "POST /posts returns 201 with the post and id; GET /posts lists posts; GET /posts/<id> returns it or 404."
      hypotheses: [h1, h2]
      must_include: ["CRUD for posts"]
      test: "test_blog_api.CrudTests.test_create_list_get"
    - id: update_and_delete
      kind: boundary
      statement: "PUT updates and DELETE removes a post; both return 404 for an unknown id."
      hypotheses: [h3]
      must_include: ["CRUD for posts"]
      test: "test_blog_api.CrudTests.test_update_delete_and_404"
    - id: api_key_required
      kind: boundary
      statement: "A missing or wrong X-API-Key yields 401 on every route and leaves the data unchanged."
      hypotheses: [h4]
      must_include: ["X-API-Key auth"]
      test: "test_blog_api.AuthTests.test_missing_or_wrong_key_is_401"
    - id: json_bodies
      kind: boundary
      statement: "Bodies are JSON; malformed JSON or a missing title yields 400 with a JSON error."
      hypotheses: [h5]
      must_include: ["JSON bodies"]
      test: "test_blog_api.JsonTests.test_bad_json_is_400"
    - id: binds_localhost_8080
      kind: boundary
      statement: "The default server address is 127.0.0.1:8080."
      hypotheses: [h6]
      must_include: ["localhost:8080"]
      test: "test_blog_api.ServerTests.test_default_address"
    - id: stdlib_single_file
      kind: boundary
      statement: "blog_api.py imports only standard-library modules and the whole app is that one file."
      hypotheses: [h6]
      must_include: ["standard library only", "single file blog_api.py"]
      test: "test_blog_api.ServerTests.test_stdlib_only_single_file"
scope:
  paths: ["blog_api.py", "tests_py/**"]
  tests: tests_py
  pythonpath: ["."]
EOF

python3 -m forgemyspec lint forgemyspec-bundle/blog-api/spec.yaml --formal && python3 -m forgemyspec package forgemyspec-bundle/blog-api/spec.yaml && python3 -m forgemyspec board start R1; python3 -m forgemyspec board verify R1; python3 -m forgemyspec board
